title: Partner Configuration
description: The Partner Configuration in the repository of the integration, changed by review and release (UC-007, BR-004). Trailhead Gear owns it. It holds the name of each Partner's API Key in the Secret Store, never the API Key itself (UC-007 BR-003). Unique identifiers and Order Number Ranges that do not overlap need all Partners together and are checked when the configuration is read (UC-007 steps 5 and 6).

partners.description: Every registered Partner. An identifier used twice is UC-007 A1; overlapping ranges are UC-007 A2.

partnerId.description: Identifier of the Partner, the one it names in every Partner Order (UC-007 BR-001).

orderNumberRange.description: Order Number Range: the first and the last number after `TG-`, both included; the last is not smaller than the first (UC-007 BR-002, A2).

orderContact.description: Order Contact, the email address that receives the Rejection Emails of the Partner (UC-007 A3).

apiKeyName.description: Name under which the Integration Team created the Partner's API Key in the Secret Store; checked against the Secret Store (UC-007 A4).
